heading: PROJECTS
description: Selected systems across open-source AI, trustworthy developer tooling, release engineering, organization automation, reliability, memory infrastructure, and measured computing research. Star counts are a snapshot from 18 October 2026.

projects.name: pollinations
projects.description: An open-source generative AI platform where I maintain contributor rewards, triage automation, application workflows, model curation, and developer tooling.

projects.name: crumb.elixpo
projects.description: A self-hosted Rust terminal agent with explicit permissions, isolated tools, supervised MCP execution, signed skill distribution, rollback, and revocation. Its execution-receipt workflow remains under validation.

projects.name: search.elixpo
projects.description: An OpenAI-compatible web-search and research system with Redis-backed conversational memory, semantic caching, retrieval, MCP tools, streaming responses, citations, and reproducible evaluation artifacts.

projects.name: packages.elixpo
projects.description: The source, release, signed APT distribution, and public catalogue for independently versioned Elixpo Linux applications, with candidate deployments and rollback documentation.

projects.name: agent.elixpo
projects.description: Elixpo's organization-wide GitHub operations agent for deterministic triage, Project V2 automation, permission-checked metadata actions, comment-only reviews, and merge records.

projects.name: status.elixpo
projects.description: A Cloudflare-native status surface that derives service health from observed traffic, distinguishes outages from unavailable monitoring, and publishes operational history across Elixpo.

projects.name: qfabric
projects.description: A research runtime for measured recovery across Linux and RTOS execution domains, with timing contracts, safe switching, replayable decisions, probation, and rollback.
